products.name: Pic Hider
products.tagline: Private photo & video vault — locked behind your PIN
products.description: Hide photos and videos behind a PIN-encrypted vault (AES-256). Fingerprint/face unlock (works on Class-2 sensors too), built-in viewer with zoom and video playback, and one-tap export back to your gallery. NEW in v1.3.0: the two biggest real-world bugs are fixed for good — 'gallery won't open' (phones whose gallery picker silently fails now get an instant one-tap file-browser fallback) and 'PIN won't save' (vault creation writes are now synchronous, so an aggressive memory killer can never eat a fresh setup; setup failures show a clear in-app message instead of crashing; the lock screen always has a manual Unlock button as a safety net). Plus app disguise (Calculator / Notes / Gallery / custom icon) and recovery question.

products.name: Ophelia Widgets
products.tagline: 31 hand-crafted widgets — now with the NewThing-style DOT MATRIX set
products.description: 31 home screen widgets in 10 categories. NEW in v1.3.0 — the DOT MATRIX batch, the Nothing-style red-on-black dot look you asked for: App Shortcut (any installed app as a dot tile), App Folder (2x2 grid of four apps), Month Calendar (dot-grid month with today lit in Ophelia red, flips at midnight), Step Counter (hardware pedometer, dot digits), Now Playing (play/pause/next/previous that steer whatever app is playing + live track title via optional notification access), Web Search (pick your engine: Google, YouTube, DuckDuckGo, Bing), AI Bar (Gemini, ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude in one tile) and Contact Dial (pick a contact once, every tap dials them). Plus the existing 23: Ophelia signature set, digital/analog clocks, date, countdowns, year/day progress, moon phase, world clock, battery ring, weather for any city, sticky notes, quotes, flashlight, search, settings shortcuts, photo frame, storage & RAM gauges, tally and decision spinner. The launcher icon is the real Ophelia artwork.

products.name: Junk Cleaner
products.tagline: Advanced junk cleaner — smart clean, system cache boost, app cache dashboard
products.description: One-tap SMART CLEAN scans shared storage for thumbnail caches, empty folders, leftover installers and temp files — everything is shown for review before deletion, nothing is removed silently. SYSTEM CACHE BOOST uses the official Android storage API pattern (the same lever Google's own tools use) to make the system evict app caches device-wide — no root. The APP CACHES dashboard lists how much cache every installed app holds and deep-links you to each app's storage settings. v1.0.1 fixes the crash-on-open some phones hit at launch (the Compose host now uses the correct activity base class — root-caused, fixed and verified). Never touches Android/data, never deletes without review, no fake RAM/CPU 'boost' nonsense.

products.name: EasyPair
products.tagline: Offline high-speed sharing between two nearby phones — no data, no limits
products.description: EasyPair by Ophelia transfers EVERYTHING between two nearby Android phones completely offline: photos, videos, audio, any files, entire folders, even installed apps (as APKs) and clipboard text — no size limit, never compressed, nothing uploaded anywhere. Flip the Visible switch and both phones find each other automatically over Wi-Fi Direct (full speed, no router needed), the same Wi-Fi, a phone hotspot, a USB data cable (USB tethering) or Bluetooth as the slow fallback. Files land in Downloads/EasyPair, text arrives as a one-tap-copy pop-up. EasyPair also appears inside every app's share sheet, and received files can be re-shared onward with any share tech on your phone. Privacy first: you are only visible while the switch is ON, transfers ask before they start, and history can be switched off entirely. A 1.3 MB app from Deadlock Studio.
